firstOcrStatus: Not run; all eight retained independent of OCR success.

scoring.normalization: Use unchanged shared normalizeOcrAnchor (NFKC, uppercase, Unicode letters/numbers). Full original source strings are anchors, not easy substrings.
scoring.positive: Every full-source anchor must have exactly its declared occurrence count. No post-OCR correction or text substitution.
scoring.inventory: Actual sourceText from all physical OCR lines must have no excess normalized character counts; this cannot substitute for anchor completeness.
scoring.paragraphs: Each complete declared paragraphGroups sequence must equal a distinct complete actual normalized source paragraph. Wrong joins or splits fail separately from anchor detection.
scoring.negative: Any actual physical OCR box intersecting a declared wordless region fails, even when all anchors are found. Whole wordless page must have zero actual text/lines.
scoring.standardPixels: All protected opaque RGB points, source dimensions/attrs, original restoration and cache replay remain strict existing gates.
scoring.additionalRgba: protectedRgbaProbes and protectedRgbaRegions carry full pre-OCR RGBA truth. A downstream suite must explicitly enforce them before claiming transparent hole/region preservation; legacy RGB-only probes are insufficient.
scoring.fairComparison: Both candidate recognizers receive identical full PNG/source settings/cache. Keep all scene results and count failed anchors/groups/negatives. Do not tune images or select crops after OCR. No speed claim from this corpus.

notes: Eight original geometrically distinct color/alpha source diagnostics, 34 full-source anchors, one wordless scene.
Lossless source and original glyph RGBA are retained; antialiased text is source-over, not a replacement alpha write.
Only source geometry, glyph composition and truth constraints have been checked; no real OCR/translation/inpainting/browser claim.

The existing helper enforces full anchors/occurrences, excess source inventory, negative regions and exact independent paragraph groups. Additional RGBA region/probe assertions require an explicit downstream pixel oracle.
System-font files are exact-SHA local rendering dependencies and are not redistributed. No external artwork or implementation copied.
